A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same X2-DFD work. All 15 pages in each version are readable, including equations, seven figures, three tables, and references. Neither supplied PDF contains an appendix.

before.justification: V1 reports original detection experiments, component ablations, feature assessments, and human evaluation in Sections 3 and 5, Tables 1–3, and Figures 2, 6–7.

after.justification: V2 retains the work's original detection experiments, ablations, feature assessments, and human evaluation, including results for the proposed model.

M1.justification: The MFA, SFS, WFS, and inference procedures remain the same. V2 newly discloses human verification of generated questions without specifying changes to selection, ranking, training, or inference. WCS/GCS label corrections refer to existing modules.

E1.justification: The FF++ training coverage, cross-dataset evaluations, six DF40 face-swapping scenarios, and human evaluation tasks are retained. FakeBench is newly discussed as related work, without being used in an experiment.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in Tables 1–3 and the human evaluation. CDFA and ProgressiveDet already appear in v1's Table 2; GPT-4o and LLaVA remain the human-evaluation comparators.

E3.justification: Section 5.1 retains the FF++ c23 protocols, one-epoch training budget, hyperparameters, and evaluation metrics. The human-evaluation procedure is unchanged, and combining the balanced-accuracy formulas does not change the metric.

E4.justification: Section 4.2.1 newly documents a human check of generated questions for errors and irrelevant information, reporting that most questions are satisfactory without quantifying errors. The component ablations and feature-capability analyses in Section 5.4 remain unchanged.

E5.justification: Both versions report point estimates without adding repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests. The new qualitative statement about question quality supplies no statistical estimation.

E6.justification: Figure 1 changes X2-DFD's fake probability for the male example from 0.37 to 0.96 without explaining the revision. V2 also adds the unquantified finding about generated-question quality. Benchmark and plotted results otherwise remain unchanged; Table 3's average AP changes only by rounding 90.32 to 90.3.

T1.justification: V2's Equation 3 substitutes the explicit TPR and TNR fractions into v1's Equations 3–4, producing mathematically identical balanced accuracy. Other mathematical definitions are retained, with no new assumptions, propositions, or proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction's contribution list, and conclusion retain the same claims about assessing intrinsic capabilities, improving detection and explanations, and integrating external detectors through an extendable framework.

C2.justification: Section 2 removes the argument that subtle deepfake artifacts make human labels potentially unsuitable as standard answers for fine-tuning. Interpretations of strong versus weak features, experimental findings, and future feedback-based extension otherwise remain unchanged.

D1.justification: Section 4.2.1 newly discloses human verification after question ranking. This adds implementation transparency, although reviewer numbers and verification procedures remain unspecified. Existing hardware, training hyperparameters, and access information are unchanged.

R1.justification: V2 adds discussion and citation of FakeBench and a GPT-4 technical-report citation, while removing Köbis et al. and the associated criticism of human annotations. These are limited changes to related-work coverage and positioning.

P1.justification: Localized edits standardize WCS/GCS terminology to WFS/SFS, streamline the balanced-accuracy explanation, and revise the related-work and MFA paragraphs. The overall section order and narrative structure are retained.

P2.justification: Figures 1 and 5 receive local formatting and label edits, including changing the SFS label in Figure 5 to WFS. Table 3's final row becomes SFS + WFS, and text reflow shifts display positions. All figures and tables are retained.

improvement.justification: Correcting inconsistent module labels in Section 4.2.3, Figure 5, and Table 3 reduces confusion, while disclosing human verification modestly improves transparency. These gains are limited: experimental and statistical support remain unchanged, and the verification procedure and Figure 1 probability revision are insufficiently explained.
